description: Fork of exp149 (d_qk=992, STE binarization, sparse scatter qk_n_sparse=32, attn_scale=0.4, 279M). exp149 trajectory plateaued at +0.030 behind exp144 by step 1800. Hypothesis: with mhlut_init_std=0.001 and ~37 sparse-scatter votes, std(qk_out at init) ≈ √(37/3)·0.001 ≈ 0.0035 — far below STE temperature τ=0.1. STE soft = x/(τ+|x|) operates in pure linear regime (soft ≈ 10x ≈ 0.035), forward gives ±1 from random init noise (signs reflect tiny weight perturbations, not learned signal), gradient amplification = 1/τ = 10× pushes against zero target. Single change: qk_mhlut_init_std = 0.001 -> 0.03 (target std(qk_out at init) = √(37/3)·0.03 ≈ 0.105 ≈ τ, putting STE near the saturation knee where soft has meaningful magnitude and signs reflect actual weight direction). Other LUTs (v, out_proj) keep mhlut_init_std=0.001.
